# What no target lowers yet is refused where it is written rather than emitted
# as a bracket that never reports: @update under a `for`, where one flag cannot
# say which copy's key was written. The interpreter runs it.

! sngl generate --platform fyne --lang go -o out loop.sngl
stderr 'loop.sngl:8:29: an effect''s @update under a `for` is not implemented on a compiled target yet'

! sngl generate --platform android --lang kotlin -o out loop.sngl
stderr 'loop.sngl:8:29: an effect''s @update under a `for` is not implemented on a compiled target yet'

-- loop.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

component rows ui.node {
    var xs list<list<int>> = [[1], [2]]
    var n = 0
    ui.vbox {
        for var x = xs {
            effect(on = x, @update { n += 1 })
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title = "Rows") {
    rows
}
